meta.title: Gay and lesbian rights
meta.question: Do Poles support equal rights for gay and lesbian couples?
meta.measure: Average position on gay and lesbian rights, from 0 (for equal rights) to 10 (against)
meta.anchor: Pooled from questions on same-sex relationships, marriage, partnerships, adoption and public life, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: Can homosexuality always be justified, never be justified, or something in between?
Would not like to have homosexuals as neighbours (mentioned = 10)
items.notes: European Values Study 1990, 1999, 2008 (3 surveys). 2017 codes the answers 1/2 and is EVS_NBR_HOMOSEX17. The regex leaves out 1999's Hungarian-only variable.

items.wording: Agree or disagree: homosexuals should be accepted
items.notes: Consolidation of Democracy in CEE, January 1991 and March 2000 (2 surveys).

items.wording: Sexual relations between two adults of the same sex: always wrong ... not wrong at all
Should gay and lesbian couples have the right to adopt children?
Should homosexuals be allowed to form organisations and associations?
items.notes: CBOS June 1994 (1 survey). The same battery's marriage and adoption items are already in CBOS_HOMO_MARRIAGE and CBOS_HOMO_ADOPT.

items.wording: Should gay and lesbian couples have the right to marry?
Should homosexuals be allowed to hold high public office?
Should homosexuals be allowed to work as teachers?
Homosexuality: always justifiable (10) ... never justifiable (1)
items.notes: World Values Survey 1997, 2005, 2012 (3 usable surveys). The 1989 wave falls before CAL_START (January 1990) and is left out by the pipeline.

items.wording: Would not like to have homosexuals as neighbours (mentioned = 10)
Would you vote in parliamentary elections for a politician you rate highly who is homosexual?
Should same-sex couples have the right to adopt children? (yes or no)
Should people of the same sex in close relationships have the right to marry? (after the Dutch law)
Should people of the same sex in a close relationship have the right to have sexual relations? (yes/no)
Homosexuality should be accepted by society (1) or should not be accepted (2)
items.notes: Pew Global Attitudes 2002, 2007, 2011, 2013, 2019, 2022 (6 surveys). In 2007-2022 the variable label is generic and the value labels pick the question out. 2002's code 3 is don't know.

items.wording: Gay men and lesbians should be free to live their own life as they wish (agree-disagree)

items.notes: CBOS 2005-07, 2005-10, 2008-05, 2010-04 (4 surveys). The later partnership wording is the existing CBOS_HOMO_PARTNER.

items.wording: Are you in favour of or opposed to specific measures to provide equal opportunities in employment for people of different sexual orientation?

How comfortable would you feel with a homosexual neighbour?
How comfortable would you feel with a gay, lesbian or bisexual person in the highest elected political position? (1 not at all ... 10 totally comfortable)
items.notes: Eurobarometer special waves on discrimination 2008, 2009, 2012, 2015, 2019, 2023 (6 surveys). 'Indifferent' (spontaneous) is no position.

items.notes: CBOS's two-statement self-placement cards (the PGSW battery's format), 2015.
